% Pattern: proof/attach/thref. The theoremref package labels a theorem with
% \thlabel and refers to it with \thref. A proof that names its theorem by
% \thref, after other statements, attaches by the reference.
% Seen in the gold pilot (set E).
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here labels=THM:main
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 2 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=lemma-1
% want proof-2 proof - proves=thm-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\usepackage{theoremref}
\newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}[thm]{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\begin{thm}\thlabel{THM:main}
A statement.
\end{thm}
\begin{lemma}
A helper.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
A step.
\end{proof}
\begin{proof}[Proof of \thref{THM:main}]
By the lemma.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
